simple.meaning: רַעֲנָן (raʻănân) is a Hebrew action word meaning “verdant ; by analogy, new ; figuratively, prosperous.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 20 times in Deuteronomy, 1 Kings, 2 Kings, 2 Chronicles, Job, and 6 more, beginning at Deuteronomy 12:2. The surrounding contexts include sacrifice, mountain.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to רַעֲנָן (H7488) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: רַעֲנָן (raʻănân) / H7488 is traced through Deuteronomy 12:2, 1 Kings 14:23, 2 Kings 16:4, 2 Kings 17:10 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.short: verdant ; by analogy, new ; figuratively, prosperous
definitions.full: H7488. raanan רַעֲנָן adjective luxuriant, fresh ; — masculine ׳ר Deut 12:2 +; feminine רַעֲנָנָה Song 1:16 ; masculine plural רַעֲנַנִּים Psa 92:15 ; — luxuriant , of trees: בְּרוֺשׁ Hosea 14:9 , זַיִת Psalm 52:10 (both simile), Jer 11:16 (figurative); simile also, ר ׳כְּאֶזְרָח Psa 37:35 (but read ᵑ6 ᵐ5 הַלְּבָנוֺן כְּאֶרֶז and most); especially in phrase ר ׳כָּלעֵֿץ תַּחַת place of idolatrous rites, Deut 12:2 ; 1Kin 14:23 ; 2Kin 16:4 2Chr 28:4 ; 2Kin 17:10 ; Jer 2:20 ; 3:6 , 13 ; Isa 57:5 ; Ezek 6:13 ; ר ׳עַלעֵֿץ Jer 17:2 (si vera lectio); leaf 17:8 (figurative); leafy couch Song 1:16 ; fresh , oil Psa 92:11 ; fresh, flourishing , person (figurative, as trees) 92:15 (+ דְּשֵׁנִים ). I. רעע (√ of following; original meaning dubious).
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to be green;

occurrences.englishText: You shall surely destroy all the places in which the nations that you shall dispossess served their gods: on the high mountains, and on the hills, and under every green tree.
For they also built for themselves high places, sacred pillars, and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every green tree.
He sacrificed and burned incense in the high places, on the hills, and under every green tree.
and they set up for themselves pillars and Asherah poles on every high hill, and under every green tree;

It will be accomplished before his time.
I have seen the wicked in great power,
My eye has also seen my enemies.
to show that Yahweh is upright.
you who inflame yourselves among the oaks,
“For long ago I broke off your yoke,

Moreover, Yahweh said to me in the days of Josiah the king, “Have you seen that which backsliding Israel has done? She has gone up on every high mountain and under every green tree, and has played the prostitute there.

Only acknowledge your iniquity, that you have transgressed against Yahweh your God, and have scattered your ways to the strangers under every green tree, and you have not obeyed my voice,’ says Yahweh.”
Yahweh called your name, “A green olive tree,
Even their children remember their altars
For he will be as a tree planted by the waters,

You will know that I am Yahweh, when their slain men are among their idols around their altars, on every high hill, on all the tops of the mountains, under every green tree, and under every thick oak, the places where they offered pleasant aroma to all their idols.
Who is wise, that he may understand these things?
